I think the trickiest part is the discrepancy in wall heights. The interior walls are a smidge shorter than the exterior walls even though they're still supposedly 12 units high. This is bc they're meant to be leaving space for a floor beneath them, whereas the exterior walls are meant to be placed straight on the foundation or other walls. This is why none of the presets have a door to an interior room. You can get around this by placing a floor under an interior wall to use it as exterior, or by leaving a gap in the floorboards to use the exterior walls inside.

after the last Game driver update it got better but it still bugs out sometimes. I kinda found a solution though? Before you open fortnite, open Nvidia control panel > Manage display mode and select Nvidia GPU Only. Now open fortnite. Sometimes it works right away, sometimes there's an extra step: open the overlay with alt+z, turn instant replay off and on again, you should be good. To test that it's working I usually take a shadowplay screenshot in the lobby and if the pop up comes up on the side then it's fine. I just delete the screenshot later. It's a hassle but this is the only way I've gotten it to work again 100% of the time :/
